name: Uptown
headline: Life by the River.
intro: Uptown is Columbus’s downtown district, centered on Broadway and the Chattahoochee riverfront. It combines dining, arts venues and outdoor destinations in a compact part of the city.

name: MidTown
headline: Find Your Corner of MidTown.
intro: MidTown is a broad Columbus district made up of smaller neighborhoods, historic streets, parks and shopping areas. It is a useful starting point if you want to compare several different residential settings within the city.

name: Lake Bottom
kicker: A PARK AT THE HEART OF YOUR ROUTINE.
headline: Make Room for Park Days.
intro: Lake Bottom, also written Lakebottom, commonly refers to the area around Weracoba/Lakebottom Park in MidTown Columbus. Nearby Weracoba–St. Elmo has a historic residential character, with several early twentieth-century architectural styles.

name: Hilton Woods/Hilton Heights
headline: Explore Hilton Woods and Hilton Heights.
intro: Hilton Woods and Hilton Heights are neighboring MidTown residential areas often discussed together. Explore established streets, ranch-style homes and convenient routes to Columbus State University, shopping and local services.

name: East Highlands
headline: Explore East Highlands.
intro: East Highlands sits in MidTown’s northwest corner, south of Talbotton Road and the Fall Line Trace. Its streets include houses from different building periods, rather than one single architectural era.
